input.question: Why can't men control their erections?
input.ground_truth: Bloodflow and blood pressure is controlled in the brain stem, making it an involuntary action. When aroused a guy can try to attack the arousal itself by picturing something else, or control his bloodflow by tensing his legs. Alternatively sometimes being extremely relaxed (half or fully asleep) can sometimes cause an erection on it's own.
